name: Yarasete! Teacher CHANGE
original_name: やらせてっ！てぃーちゃー CHANGE
source:
As luck would have it, we, the regular cast of Yarasete Teacher, are all still at the same academy!

And I, Kenji Otsu, who've only been in a supporting role to Yuta till now, finally get the spotlight.
You heard right—I'm happy to announce that I will be appearing as the protagonist this time!

Of course, Yuta and his friends are still doing well.
At first, Yuta was a little down because he couldn't be near Ms. Riko as much.
But with his natural positivity(?), he seems to be enjoying academy life again.
He also seems to be meeting with Ms. Riko secretly after class...
So I guess that whole love triangle with Nagisa is still a thing?

Hm, speaking of things that have changed since last time...
It seems that Hiroshi and Kumiko are really dating now. I'm kinda surprised.

But yeah, back to me—the protagonist, Kenji Otsu!
Lately, I can't stop thinking about my own homeroom teacher, Ms. Asahina.

She's also the gym teacher, so she usually wears jerseys.
I don't know how to put this, but it really lets me appreciate her curves.
I can't help but stare at her boobs. They're so freaking huge…
The way they bounce around when she moves, too... Hehehe.

What? That's out of character for me, you say? Well, I've grown up some too, you know.
Oh, and I've been keeping this on the down-low, but I can be crafty too, as you'll soon see!

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/yarasetetthichachenji-ja/]Johren[/url]]
translation:
说来也是幸运，《让我们来吧！教师》的常驻角色们全都还在同一所学园里！

而我，大津健二，之前一直只是裕太的配角，这次终于轮到我登上舞台了。
没错——很高兴宣布，这次我将担任主人公！

当然，裕太和他的朋友们也过得很好。
起初，裕太因为不能经常待在理子老师身边而有些消沉。
但凭借他天生的乐观（？），他似乎又开始享受学园生活了。
他好像还在放学后偷偷和理子老师见面……
所以，我想他和渚之间的三角关系还在继续？

嗯，说到和上次相比发生的变化……
浩和久美子似乎真的在交往了。真让我有点吃惊。

不过，还是回到我身上吧——主人公大津健二！
最近，我满脑子都是自己的班主任朝比奈老师。

她同时也是体育老师，所以平时穿着运动服。
我不知道该怎么说，但那确实让我更加注意到她的曲线。
我忍不住盯着她的胸部。实在是大得夸张……
还有她走动时上下晃动的样子……嘿嘿。

什么？你说这不像我？嗯，我也成长了一些嘛。
哦，还有一件事我一直低调保密——我其实也很会耍心机，你们马上就会知道了！
